## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán is the Northern Sòng Huáyán-school's ritual manual for cultivating and verifying the *Pǔxián xíngyuàn* — the *Practice-Vow of Samantabhadra*, the foundational devotional text of the *Avataṃsaka* tradition (cf. *[the 40-fascicle Sì shí Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0041)*). The *xiūzhèng yí* "cultivation-verification ritual" provides the liturgical framework for the practitioner's vow-cultivation, integrating recitation of the *Pǔxián xíngyuàn pǐn* with contemplative-doctrinal instruction.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity at the Huìyīnsì in Hángzhōu. The work is part of his comprehensive Huáyán-school revival project; alongside the *Shū-Chāo* editorial work and the *Huán yuán guān* materials, the present ritual manual provided the practical-devotional framework for Sòng Huáyán monastic practice.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1472) collection.
